**Do not edit this file.** As in the data collection repository, the 0.75x scale, link masses
(body 0.78 kg + 4 x 0.005 kg rotors = 0.8 kg), rotor joint locking and zeroed initial velocities are
applied by the asset config (`assets/drones.py`), not stored in the USD.

## Original structure

- defaultPrim `/vehicle` (articulation root, self collision on), Z up, metres.
- `/vehicle/body`: rigid body, 1.5 kg with a stored `diagonalInertia` (0.029125, 0.029125, 0.055225)
  kg·m² from the PX4 Gazebo Iris. This must be cleared when the mass is overridden so the inertia is
  recomputed from the shape. The collider is one body+arms mesh (convex decomposition).
- `/vehicle/rotor0..3`: propeller rigid bodies (no mass set), `rotorN/jointN` revolute about z.
- Narrowest waist width at x = 0 is about 105 mm at full scale, about 79 mm at 0.75x. The gripper
  opens 107 mm, so the drone must be scaled.

## Files used by drone_grasp_rl

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `iris_0p75.usda` | Entry point (`assets/drones.py`). References `iris.usd` and overrides scale 0.75, masses (body 0.78 kg, rotors 4 x 0.005 kg), explicit inertia and center of mass (values PhysX computes from the scaled colliders, so PhysX and Newton use the same), rotor joints locked by +-0.01 deg limits (MuJoCo rejects an empty 0..0 range), zero initial velocities. Hand-written. |
| `iris_collision.usda` | Sublayer of `iris_0p75.usda`, generated by `scripts/build_drone_collision.py`. Turns off collision on the original body mesh (it stays visible) and adds 30 invisible convex-hull pieces from a fixed CoACD decomposition (seed 0). |

Why the collider is pre-decomposed: the original body collider is `convexDecomposition`. PhysX cooks its
own decomposition, while Newton runs CoACD at load time, so the pieces differed between engines and
between runs. One near-zero-volume piece also made MuJoCo fail with "mesh volume is too small".
Waist width at drone x = 0, 0.75x: original mesh 78.4 mm, convex pieces 83.0 mm. The old repository
measured 81.3 mm with PhysX's own decomposition. The gripper opens 107 mm and the grasp criterion is
87 mm or less.
